result.evidence:
HOW MUCH OF S3 IS DONE: the server half is mostly built. The page half, which is S3's whole task now, has not been started.

Branch state: v2/s3 is at 6fad986, 13 commits ahead of master, and v2/s3-server is at that same commit. The branch is not rebased: master has 3 newer commits, among them 155d352, which made S3 pages-only and gave the server half to the helper as Task 24. `git diff --stat master...HEAD` lists only server/api_today.py (+1712), server/daily.py (+503), server/checks/s3.py (+1121), server/test_flow.py (3 lines) and server/cache/twin_supply.json. `git diff master...HEAD -- web/` is empty, so web/index.html, the only file S3 owns, is still the 253-line v1 home page.

1. Checks
- `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/checks/s3.py` prints "S3 today checks passed". Every item is ok except one skip: "R&W seeds clamped for this check: words.daily_item's seeds overflow SQLite (S9, Task 18)".
- `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/test_flow.py` fails. The error is `OverflowError: Python int too large to convert to SQLite INTEGER`, raised in server/words.py:186 `_review_row`, reached via checks/s9.py:332 `test_daily_print_offline`. I got the same failure on master (I detached to master, ran it, then detached back to v2/s3), so S3 did not cause it.

2. Page walk
I ran uvicorn on port 8023 with server/v2.db, which is gitignored, and stopped it afterwards. I walked the page with Playwright at 1280 and at 390, once as a new learner and once as a seeded one (a day's question answered, exam Nov 7, target 650).
- All four runs had no console or page errors, and scrollWidth matched the viewport (1280 and 390).
- Present: #next, #qotd, #exam, #score.
- Absent: #mist, #study, #plan, #chal, #tests, dialog#targetSheet, dialog#tryOne, the calendar, and any [data-slot] tabs for the day's questions.
- The server returns 2 day's-question slots (math:mcq, math:spr), but the page draws 1 stem.
- #next has 0 size chips, and there are no SEC or DAYS count boxes.
- None of the empty-state texts appear (Add your name, 0 of 3, When is your SAT?, No score yet, No tests yet).
- The first tap on a day's-question option sends POST /api/qotd right away.
- With /api/challenge aborted, there is no "Couldn't load the challenge." and no Retry.
- The branch server still accepts the v1 page: a POST to /api/qotd without a slot returns 200, and GET still returns the top-level question and mine.

3. Sample of 15 requirements
None of the 15 is built on the page.
- From §3.2.8: #15 empty states with actions, #16 the two day's questions side by side at 1280, tabs at 390 and the card order, #17 PLAN · 0 of 1 done, #18 Rest day and Practice anyway, #19 Resume and Continue to module 2, #20 the SEC and DAYS boxes and the local date, #21 Target ✎ and #targetSheet, #22 the exam-date popover, #23 first tap only selects, then percentages and misconception lines, #24 Continue · 2 of N, #25 Try one now and #tryOne, #26 calendar day detail, #27 per-card errors with Retry.
- From today.md: T1 #7 (10 size chips in #next), the twin bottom sheet at 390, and insights #5 (#gain with 19 skill rows under TOP 6).
- The branch's server items that checks/s3.py covers do pass, but those are now the helper's (Task 24).

4. Ownership and decisions
- The branch diff touches only server files, none of which S3 owns now. They are the earlier S3 commits, identical to v2/s3-server's.
- The diff has nothing about classes, teachers, homework, assignments, /join/ or payment. Nothing in it contradicts spec/v2-decisions.md.
- The worktree is clean after the walk, and I made no commits.

defects.what: The v2 Today page has not been built: the file is unchanged from master and is still the v1 page. It has only #next, #qotd, #exam and #score. It has no #mist, #study, #plan, #chal or #tests cards, no dialog#targetSheet or #tryOne, no calendar, no size chips and no SEC/DAYS countdown, and it draws one day's question instead of the twins. §3.2.8 page items 15-27 and today.md's page items all fail.
defects.fix: Build Part 3.2 as pages-only in web/index.html, following the S3 brief on master, against the endpoints on v2/s3-server. Where an endpoint has not landed yet, the card should degrade quietly.

defects.what: The first tap on a day's-question option sends POST /api/qotd straight away. §3.2.8 #23 and today.md T1 item 5 say the first tap only selects and Check sends the request.
defects.fix: Put a separate select step and a Check button in front of UI.question's onAnswer, as part of the Today page build.

defects.what: There is no per-card error or Retry. With /api/challenge aborted, no challenge card shows "Couldn't load the challenge." with Retry, and a failed /api/today has no shared Retry either (§3.2.8 #27).
defects.fix: Give each card an error state, and one Retry that repaints every card fed by /api/today, as part of the page build.

defects.what: test_flow.py does not print "all good": it stops with OverflowError: Python int too large to convert to SQLite INTEGER. The same failure happens on master, so it comes from S9 (words.daily_item seeds), not from S3.
defects.fix: S9/Task 18 should clamp or hash words.daily_item seeds into SQLite's 64-bit range. It is outside S3's files, so report it to the owner.

defects.what: The branch is not rebased onto master, which has 3 newer commits including 155d352 (S3 made pages-only). So the S3.md and S3-check.md in the worktree are the older 'server and pages' versions.
defects.fix: The next builder should run git rebase master before starting the page work.

defects.what: The branch diff touches only files S3 no longer owns: server/api_today.py, server/daily.py, server/checks/s3.py, server/test_flow.py and server/cache/twin_supply.json. They are the predecessor's commits, identical to v2/s3-server (helper Task 24).
defects.fix: Merge the server half once, through v2/s3-server. When v2/s3 is merged after it, those commits should already be in master, leaving only web/index.html as S3's delta.
